Rabia Yilmaz  
Email: rabia.yilmaz@email.com | Phone: (555) 123-4567 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/rabia-yilmaz | Location: Istanbul, Turkey  

Professional Experience  
As a senior mobile developer at MoneyFlow Solutions, I’ve led the architecture and delivery of cross-platform financial apps, optimizing performance and user engagement. My work has focused on balancing technical rigor with business needs, ensuring seamless integration across iOS and Android while maintaining compliance with fintech regulations. Prior to joining MoneyFlow in 2019, I spent two years as a mobile developer at a mid-sized fintech firm, where I spearheaded the migration of legacy apps to Flutter, reducing maintenance costs by 30% and improving deployment speed. Before that, I started my career as a junior developer at a FinTech Startup, where I contributed to the development of a mobile wallet app that achieved 150,000 active users within its first year.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering, Istanbul Technical University, 2016. Thesis: “Optimizing Resource Allocation in Mobile Payment Systems Using Predictive Analytics.”  

Professional Summary  
With seven years of experience in fintech, I specialize in building scalable, secure mobile solutions that drive user adoption and operational efficiency. My expertise spans both iOS and Android ecosystems, with a particular focus on Swift for complex financial workflows and Kotlin for Android-specific features. I’ve led teams through the adoption of Flutter for cross-platform development, ensuring consistent performance across devices while reducing time-to-market. My career has been defined by solving real-world problems—whether it’s improving transaction security, streamlining user onboarding, or integrating with third-party financial APIs. I approach each project with a balance of technical precision and business acumen, ensuring that the final product meets both user needs and organizational goals.  

Projects  
At MoneyFlow Solutions, I led the development of a real-time transaction tracking app that reduced user-reported crashes by 40% through proactive memory management and error logging. The app was built using Flutter for cross-platform consistency and Swift for iOS-specific features like biometric authentication. I also designed a mobile CI/CD pipeline that cut deployment cycles from three days to under two hours, enabling faster iteration and bug fixes. At the mid-sized fintech firm, I refactored a legacy Android app using Kotlin, improving code maintainability and reducing technical debt by 25%. This project also involved integrating with a third-party payment gateway, which increased transaction success rates by 12%.
